Implement Test Case 4: Massive Change Trigger. Delete all files, run dctx, verify Major bump (V2) and diff cleanup.

arguments.subject: CORRECTIVE: Fix Environment Isolation in Integrity Test
arguments.description: Restructuring tools/test-integrity.sh to prevent the mock HOME environment from interfering with the Cargo build process. The build step will now run in the host environment, and environment overrides will be applied specifically to the dctx execution steps.
tasks: Update tools/test-integrity.sh: Move environment exports after the build step.

arguments.subject: CORRECTIVE: Standardize Cache Path Resolution on macOS
arguments.description: The current implementation of get_cache_dir strictly enforces macOS standards (~/Library/Caches) while ignoring the XDG_CACHE_HOME environment variable. This breaks the isolated testing environment and contradicts the behavior of the config directory resolution. This order updates the logic to prioritize XDG variables if present, ensuring testability and standard CLI behavior.
tasks: Update crates/dctx-core/src/config.rs: Modify get_cache_dir to check XDG_CACHE_HOME before falling back to ~/Library/Caches on macOS.
Operator Action: Re-run tools/test-integrity.sh.

arguments.subject: Standardization of Cache Paths (Unix/Windows)
arguments.description: Refactoring config.rs to treat macOS and Linux uniformly regarding cache storage (~/.cache/dctx), while maintaining standard Windows behavior (%LOCALAPPDATA%). This resolves the platform discrepancy in testing and simplifies the directory structure logic.
tasks: Update crates/dctx-core/src/config.rs: Rewrite get_cache_dir to use a binary switch (Windows vs Unix-like).
Operator Action: Re-run tools/test-integrity.sh to confirm the fix.

arguments.subject: CRITICAL CORRECTIVE: Fix Template Parser State Machine Hijack
arguments.description: The template parser incorrectly identified content lines wrapped in brackets (e.g. [DIRECTORY:...]) as section headers, causing it to abort parsing the [LAYOUT] section. This resulted in blank output files. The fix restricts section header detection to explicitly known keywords.
tasks: Update crates/dctx-core/src/template.rs: Restrict section switching to explicitly matched keywords ([VARIABLES], [LAYOUT], etc.) instead of generic bracket checking.

arguments.subject: Corrective: Fix Lazy Version Bump & Clipboard Diff Logic

tasks: Update crates/dctx-cli/src/main.rs: Modify logic to FORCE diff generation if writing_diff_only is true, regardless of config.
